title: Recipe repo sync
lead: Clone, pull, commit and push the household's recipe repo (`recipe_repo_url`) using a repo-scoped deploy key (ADR 0012).
boundary: **Not in this slice:** the importer; any admin UI for conflicts (this slice only exposes `status()`; the page is S66); the scheduler itself (S64).

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: Recipes live in git. larder must read the latest version and push its own changes without ever needing broader credentials. The git host is whatever `recipe_repo_url` names; any host that accepts a deploy key works (ADR 0012).

sections.heading: Owner input
sections.body:
Owner checklist (the owner does these on their git host; no agent runs host tooling or touches the host):
1. Create an empty repo on your git host and set `recipe_repo_url` (in `larder.toml` or `LARDER_RECIPE_REPO_URL`).
2. Generate a deploy key with write access and add its public half to that repo in the host's settings. Put the private key at `$LARDER_DATA/secrets/deploy_key` (or the `[secrets] deploy_key` path), mode 0600. It is never committed.
3. Add the host's SSH key to `$LARDER_DATA/secrets/known_hosts` so ssh never prompts.

Decisions:
4. Sync cadence: on startup, every N minutes (recommend 15) and after each write?
5. On divergence: rebase local commits onto the remote (recommended), or stop and show "needs attention"?

Owner decisions: 2026-11-04, settled by ADR 0018 (S09): larder commits straight to main as larder <larder@localhost> (configurable in larder.toml), one imperative sentence per commit such as 'Add pad-thai.' or 'Update pad-thai.'; no pull requests.

Owner decisions: 2026-11-04, answered by the owner: (4) sync on startup, every 15 minutes and after each write; (5) on divergence rebase local commits onto the remote, and if the rebase conflicts stop and show 'needs attention'. The owner checklist items 1 to 3 (repo, deploy key, known_hosts) are the owner's own later task and are needed only for the last Check line; the build and its tests use a local bare repo and do not wait for them.

Owner decisions: 2026-11-04, answered in the spec check: (a) the commit identity is a [git] table in larder.toml with optional author_name and author_email, defaulting to 'larder' and 'larder@localhost'; this changes config.py, Settings, larder.example.toml, docs/specs/architecture.md and tests/test_config.py, which are in this slice's scope; (b) the startup sync is a first-run delay on the scheduler: Scheduler.register gains an optional first-run delay (src/larder/scheduler.py and tests/test_scheduler.py change, in this slice's scope) and the sync job registers with a delay of 0, so it runs on the scheduler thread within about a second of start(), only in the process that holds the lock.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Wrap git via subprocess.run([...], check=True) with no shell. Set GIT_SSH_COMMAND to ssh -i <key> -o IdentitiesOnly=yes -o BatchMode=yes -o UserKnownHostsFile=<known_hosts> -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes.
2. Functions take settings first: ensure_clone(settings), pull(settings), commit(settings, paths, message), push(settings), status(settings) -> RepoStatus. RepoStatus is a frozen dataclass: state (not_cloned, ok or needs_attention), detail, last_sync_at, ahead, behind, conflicted_files. S66 renders it. Pending commits must be named in status, never labelled synced.
3. Divergence policy per Owner input; abort the rebase on conflict and write the status to .git/larder-status.json inside the clone (never committed), so a later process can read it. Clone setup is inside the pull error handler. Pull and commit require main and persist needs_attention on another branch. Reject empty or whitespace-only messages before staging.
4. Take an exclusive fcntl.flock on $LARDER_DATA/recipes.lock around git operations so the scheduler and requests do not race.
5. Log commands without secrets. Persist sanitized fetch, rebase and push failure details as needs_attention.
6. register_sync(scheduler, settings, interval_seconds=900) registers recipe-sync on the scheduler with first_run_delay=0. Under one recipe lock, the job runs _pull and, only on success with ahead > 0, _push, retrying earlier rejected pushes. S13 adds the index hook later.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- Repo tests pass against a local bare repo.
- With the owner: the owner checklist is done, the real repo clones, and a test commit pushes (then is reverted only if the owner asks).
